title: fix(W1040): report resolved Fn::ToJsonString errors under W1040

files.patch:
@@ -40,6 +40,9 @@ def fn_tojsonstring(
             )
             return
 
+        resolved_rule = self.child_rules[self.resolved_rule]
         for err in super().validate(validator, s, instance, schema):
-            err.rule = self
+            # keep resolved-value errors under the W1040 child rule
+            if resolved_rule is None or err.rule is not resolved_rule:
+                err.rule = self
             yield err

@@ -3,10 +3,12 @@
 SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT-0
 """
 
+import json
 from collections import deque
 
 import pytest
 
+from cfnlint.api import lint
 from cfnlint.context.context import Transforms
 from cfnlint.jsonschema import CfnTemplateValidator, ValidationError
 from cfnlint.rules.functions.Ref import Ref
@@ -154,3 +156,20 @@ def test_validate(name, instance, schema, context_evolve, expected, rule, contex
     )(context=context, cfn=cfn)
     errs = list(rule.fn_tojsonstring(validator, schema, instance, {}))
     assert errs == expected, f"Test {name!r} got {errs!r}"
+
+
+def test_resolved_errors_use_w1040():
+    template = {
+        "AWSTemplateFormatVersion": "2010-09-09",
+        "Transform": "AWS::LanguageExtensions",
+        "Resources": {
+            "Queue": {
+                "Type": "AWS::SQS::Queue",
+                "Properties": {
+                    "VisibilityTimeout": {"Fn::ToJsonString": [1, 2]},
+                },
+            },
+        },
+    }
+    matches = lint(json.dumps(template), regions=["us-east-1"])
+    assert [m.rule.id for m in matches] == ["W1040"]
